stock.title: Stock
stock.settings.title: Stock
stock.badge.controlledTitle: Controlled substance: kept in the register
stock.badge.socialTitle: Socially significant: a lower markup cap
stock.badge.eRxTitle: Dispensed by e-prescription in e-prescription areas
stock.resolution.shortage: Lost on the way: write it off
stock.warning.over_price_cap: Price lowered to the legal cap
stock.col.name: Item
stock.col.onSaleHint: Not expired, not in quarantine and not recalled
stock.field.name: Name
stock.products.description: Your catalogue with its prescription, controlled and storage marks. Stock and prices of medicines on hand come from their deliveries.
stock.products.emptyBody: Import your catalogue from a spreadsheet: names, active ingredients, barcodes, prescription flags and prices.
stock.form.description: A medicine is named by its active ingredient, strength, form and pack, e.g. Paratsetamol 500 mg tabletka №20.
stock.form.nameHint: As people search for it at the counter.
stock.form.innHint: Latin, e.g. amoxicillin; a combination joined with +.
stock.form.partsHint: Blisters, ampoules or tablets sold separately; 1 sells whole packs only.
stock.form.pickManufacturer: Pick or type a new one
stock.form.rxHint: Everything not on the Ministry of Health's OTC list.
stock.form.eRxHint: Antibiotics and systemic hormones in e-prescription areas.
stock.form.mandatoryHint: Every pharmacy must keep it on sale.
stock.form.restrictedHint: A starred strong-acting medicine: only at licensed or social pharmacies.
stock.form.controlHint: Narcotics, psychotropics and precursors are received only at a licensed pharmacy.
stock.form.referenceHint: The registry's maximum; a prescription batch is never priced above it.
stock.form.mxikHint: The product code of the tax classifier.
stock.form.salePriceHint: For items without batches; batches carry their own price.
stock.form.partPriceHint: Empty: the pack price divided by the parts, rounded up.
stock.form.capNote: A prescription medicine is priced at most its purchase price plus the legal markup cap, and never above the reference price.
stock.form.errParts: A pack has at least one part.
stock.import.title: Import medicines
stock.import.description: XLSX or CSV with a header row. Rows match the catalogue by barcode, then SKU; the rest are added.
stock.import.dropHint: XLSX or CSV, up to 20 000 rows
stock.import.columnsHint: Columns recognised by their header: name, INN, barcode, SKU, form, strength, parts per pack, manufacturer, country, category, Rx, controlled class, storage, price, reference price, mandatory, socially significant, registration, MXIK, VAT.
stock.importField.name: name
stock.drawer.title: Item
stock.drawer.noMovements: Nothing moved in the last year.
stock.drawer.analogsTitle: Same active ingredient, form and strength
stock.drawer.analogsNote: A catalogue fact for the pharmacist to choose from, not advice.
stock.drawer.noAnalogs: No other item with the same active ingredient, form and strength.
stock.kpi.lowHint: Items under the minimum set for a pharmacy
stock.kpi.negativeHint: Sold before their delivery was entered
stock.levels.description: What each pharmacy holds, how much of it is on sale, and the nearest expiry. A row opens the item's batches.
stock.levels.estimate: Until sales lines arrive from the cash register, stock moves only by deliveries, transfers, write-offs and counts: treat it as an estimate.
stock.levels.emptyBody: Enter what is on the shelves with series and expiry, or post the first delivery.
stock.opening.title: Opening stock
stock.opening.description: What is on the shelf today, by series. Each entry adds a batch; the dialog stays open for the next one.
stock.opening.costHint: What a pack cost, VAT included.
stock.opening.priceHint: Empty: the markup's price, at most the legal cap for prescription medicines.
stock.opening.errSeries: Give the series printed on the pack.
stock.opening.errQuantity: Give how much is on the shelf.
stock.expiry.description: What expired and what expires soon, with its value. Select batches to send them where they sell sooner, mark them down or write them off.
stock.expiry.emptyBody: No batch on hand expires within {n} days.
stock.expiry.expiredCantMove: Expired goods can't be sent: write them off.
stock.expiry.markdownTitle: Mark down {n} batch | Mark down {n} batches
stock.expiry.markdownBody: The new price per pack. A prescription medicine stays at most at its legal cap.
stock.expiry.markedDown: {n} batch marked down. | {n} batches marked down.
stock.receipts.description: Deliveries against the distributors' invoices. A pharmacist fills in a draft and sends it for posting; posting puts the goods on stock and opens the payable.
stock.receipts.emptyBody: Enter a distributor's delivery with series, expiry and cost: posting it puts the goods on stock.
stock.receipt.title: Goods receipt
stock.receipt.newDescription: The pharmacy, the distributor and its invoice. Add the lines next.
stock.receipt.noSuppliers: Add distributors first, on the Distributors page.
stock.receipt.dueHint: Empty: the invoice date plus the distributor's payment terms.
stock.receipt.posted: Posted: the goods are on stock.
stock.receipt.voidPosted: Its goods leave stock and its unpaid payable is cancelled. Not possible once some of the goods moved or the distributor was paid.
stock.receipt.voidDraft: The draft is kept as void.
stock.receipt.blocked: A line can't be received at this pharmacy: it isn't licensed for that medicine. Remove the line or receive it at a licensed pharmacy.
stock.receipt.waitingHint: Check the lines and their warnings, then post.
stock.receipt.noFile: No photo or file of the invoice.
stock.line.costHint: As the invoice charges it, VAT included.
stock.line.rxPriceHint: Empty: the pricing rules' price, at most the legal cap. A higher price is lowered to the cap when posted.
stock.line.supplierRxHint: When it says prescription and the catalogue doesn't, the line warns.
stock.line.errSeries: Give the series printed on the pack.
stock.transfers.description: Goods sent between your pharmacies: the same series leave and arrive.
stock.transfers.emptyBody: Send goods that sell better at another pharmacy, or what expires soon where it sells faster.
stock.transfer.title: Transfer
stock.transfer.newDescription: Without a series, the earliest-expiring ones go first.
stock.transfer.sendNowHint: The goods leave the stock at once and are on the way until received.
stock.transfer.errLines: Add what goes, with a quantity.
stock.transfer.disputedNote: Less arrived than was sent. The missing goods stay on the way until a manager decides what happened.
stock.transfer.resolveTitle: What happened to the missing goods?
stock.transfer.voidSent: The goods return to the sending pharmacy's stock.
stock.transfer.voidDraft: The draft is kept as void.
stock.writeoffs.description: Goods taken off stock, with their act. Unfit goods are destroyed by a commission within the legal term.
stock.writeoffs.emptyBody: Expired, damaged or recalled goods are proposed for write-off here or from the expiry board.
stock.writeoff.title: Write-off
stock.writeoff.newDescription: The pharmacy, the reason and the series. Add photos on its page.
stock.writeoff.unfitNote: Unfit goods are destroyed by a commission with photos and an act, within the legal term after approval.
stock.writeoff.fitNote: A shortage or the pharmacy's own use has no destruction step.
stock.writeoff.errLines: Pick each series and give a quantity.
stock.writeoff.destroyNote: Destroy these goods by {day}: a commission, photos and the act.
stock.destroy.title: Record the destruction
stock.destroy.description: The act takes every field the law asks for. Photos or videos of the destruction are kept with it.
stock.destroy.needPhoto: Add at least one photo of the destruction on the page first.
stock.destroy.orderHint: The owner's order naming the responsible person.
stock.destroy.saved: Destruction recorded: the act is ready.
stock.destroy.errCommission: The commission needs at least {n} members with names.
stock.counts.description: Counts of the shelves, blind: counters see the series and expiry, never what the books expect.
stock.counts.newDescription: One line for each series on hand, frozen now.
stock.counts.emptyBody: Count a shelf, a category or the whole pharmacy.
stock.count.title: Stock count
stock.count.startedToast: Count started: {n} line. | Count started: {n} lines.
stock.count.blindNote: Type what is on the shelf, in packs and loose parts. Lines left empty change nothing.
stock.count.reviewNote: {n} line differs from the books. | {n} lines differ from the books.
stock.count.submittedToast: Counted: a manager reviews and applies it.
stock.count.appliedToast: Applied: stock now matches the count.
stock.count.foundDescription: Goods the books don't list: they get their own series.
stock.recalls.description: Series a regulator rejected or a distributor recalled: every matching batch leaves sale in every pharmacy until it is written off.
stock.recalls.newDescription: Every batch of this series in every pharmacy goes off sale at once, and each pharmacy holding it gets a task.
stock.recalls.emptyBody: When the regulator publishes rejected series, register the ones you may hold.
stock.recall.title: Recall
stock.recall.notFoundBody: None of this series was found in your pharmacies.
stock.recall.sourceHint: The list or letter: its number and date.
stock.recall.productHint: Pick it from the catalogue, or give its INN or name below.
stock.recall.errProduct: Pick the item or give its INN or name.
stock.recall.foundToast: Found in {n} place: off sale now. | Found in {n} places: off sale now.
stock.suppliers.description: Distributors and their terms. The payment days set each receipt's due date.
stock.suppliers.formDescription: It is added to Finance's counterparties too.
stock.suppliers.emptyBody: Add the distributors you buy from, with their payment terms.
stock.supplier.name: Name
stock.supplier.termsHint: Days after the invoice. Empty: paid on delivery.
stock.supplier.dealerHint: The importer or an official dealer of the imported medicines it brings; a receipt of imported goods from anyone else warns.
stock.journals.description: The journals an inspector asks for, made from the stock records. The numbered, laced and sealed books stay the legal record: print these pages to copy into or attach to them.
stock.journals.closeBy: Count the controlled medicines and close this month by {day}.
stock.journals.unrecorded: {n} issue without a prescription | {n} issues without a prescription
stock.journals.empty: No controlled medicine was on hand or moved this month.
stock.journals.paperNote: Quantities are in parts. A difference is reported to the internal affairs bodies and the Ministry of Health within the days set in Settings › Stock.
stock.journals.noLicenceBody: The register runs at pharmacies licensed for narcotics and psychotropics: mark them in Settings › Branches.
stock.journals.closeDescription: Give the counted balance of each medicine. A difference is reported to the authorities.
stock.journals.closedToast: Month closed: the count matches the register.
stock.journals.differences: Month closed with {n} difference: report it. | Month closed with {n} differences: report them.
stock.journals.reportHint: The day the internal affairs bodies and the Ministry of Health were told.
stock.settings.legalNote: Legal numbers default to the values the law gave on 21.10.2026. Check them with your pharmacist or lawyer; changing one is your decision.
stock.settings.pricesBody: A new batch's price is its cost plus the markup, rounded up; a prescription medicine's is capped, rounded down, and never above the reference price.
stock.settings.roundingHint: Up for a price, down under a cap.
stock.settings.jumpHint: A delivery costing more than the last one by this much warns.
stock.settings.capEnforced: Refuse prices above a legal cap
stock.settings.capEnforcedHint: Off: such a price is only flagged.
stock.settings.expiryBody: The warnings before expiry, the shelf life a delivery should have, and how stock is taken.
stock.settings.stepsHint: Days, e.g. 90, 60, 30. The expiry day always warns.
stock.settings.fefoHint: Taking a later series while an earlier one is on sale needs a reason.
stock.settings.negativeHint: Sales recorded before their delivery wait for it instead of being refused.
stock.settings.legalBody: Destruction of unfit goods and the controlled-substance register.
stock.settings.reportDaysHint: To the internal affairs bodies and the Ministry of Health.
stock.settings.psychoStockHint: Of the need; more warns at delivery.
stock.settings.rxBody: How long prescriptions are kept, by kind, and how long they are valid.
stock.settings.rxLogHint: Dispensed prescription medicines are recorded. Never a patient's name or ID.
stock.settings.appBody: What pharmacists see in the Telegram app.
stock.settings.otherBranchesHint: The stock lookup shows what your other pharmacies have.
stock.settings.cameraHint: Where the phone supports it; typing always works.
stock.settings.errSteps: Give up to six day counts, e.g. 90, 60, 30.
stock.defektura.description: What customers asked for and a pharmacy couldn't give, and the mandatory medicines the daily check found missing: what to buy next.
stock.defektura.newDescription: Pick the item, or write what the customer asked for.
stock.defektura.emptyBody: When a customer asks for something you don't have, note it here or in the app.
stock.defektura.phoneHint: Only to call the customer back.
stock.defektura.productHint: Not in the catalogue? Write its name below.
stock.defektura.name: What they asked for
stock.defektura.errItem: Pick the pharmacy and the item, or write its name.
stock.rules.title: Pricing rules
stock.rules.body: Markups by category and cost band; the first rule that matches a new batch sets its markup, else the OTC markup above. Prescription medicines stay under their legal cap.
stock.rules.dialogBody: Leave the category empty for every category, and the costs empty for any cost.
stock.rules.none: No rules: every new batch takes the OTC markup.
stock.widget.expired: {n} expired batch still on hand | {n} expired batches still on hand
stock.widget.toPost: {n} receipt to post | {n} receipts to post
stock.widget.toApprove: {n} write-off to approve | {n} write-offs to approve
stock.widget.disputed: {n} transfer arrived short | {n} transfers arrived short
stock.widget.mandatory: {n} mandatory medicine missing | {n} mandatory medicines missing
stock.widget.low: {n} item below its minimum | {n} items below their minimum
stock.lineImport.title: Lines from the distributor's invoice
stock.lineImport.description: XLSX or CSV of the invoice. Items are found by the distributor's code, the barcode or the exact name; a row that matches nothing is listed for you to add by hand.
stock.lineImport.columnsHint: Columns it reads: code, barcode or name; series; expiry date; quantity in packs; price per pack; VAT. The columns you use are remembered for this distributor.
stock.lineImport.counts: To add: {added} · not in the catalogue: {unmatched} · skipped: {skipped}
stock.priceTags.title: Print price tags
stock.priceTags.description: Items whose price changed lately, at the price this pharmacy sells next, each with a signature line. Prescription medicines print on a separate counter list: they are not displayed to the public.
stock.priceTags.days: Price changed in the last days
stock.priceTags.failed: The price tags couldn't be made.
stock.recallImport.title: The regulator's list of rejected series
stock.recallImport.description: XLSX or CSV of the list. Each series of a medicine in your catalogue becomes a recall: found in stock, it leaves sale in every pharmacy and each of them gets a task. A dry run shows what each row finds first.
stock.recallImport.sourceHint: Title, number and date, e.g. Rejected series list No. 44, 01.11.2026
stock.recallImport.columnsHint: Columns it reads: the medicine's name, INN or barcode; the series; the reason. Rows of medicines you don't carry are only counted.
stock.recallImport.counts: To register: {registered} · found in stock: {found} · not carried: {notCarried}
